lambda_update_strategy_detail: Application code deploys build an immutable ECR image tag/digest and update the existing Lambda image URI (aws lambda update-function-code). Full OpenTofu apply is required only when infrastructure configuration changes. Rollback redeploys the previous known-good image URI.
